latest_release.body:
## New Features
* feat: allow custom CodeEditor languages by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20995
* feat: lazy load table column and infolist entry state by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21016
* feat: customize lazy-loading placeholders by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21040
* Feature: Partially render editable table column cells after state updates by @webard in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20922
* Add loading placeholders for enhanced form fields and charts by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21046
* feat: add loading placeholders for JavaScript renderers by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21047
* Add selectableRecordsQuery() to count selectable records with one query by @TheGeekyM in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20945
* Add policy authorization to inline editable table columns by @TheGeekyM in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20947
* feat: improve table rendering performance by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21049

## What's Changed
* chore(deps): bump zizmorcore/zizmor-action from 0.6.4 to 0.7.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20819
* chore(deps): bump stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action from 7.2.0 to 7.2.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20917
* chore(deps): bump zizmorcore/zizmor-action from 0.7.1 to 0.8.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/20920
* chore(deps): bump zizmorcore/zizmor-action from 0.8.0 to 0.8.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21029
* fix: avoid :has() in input wrapper content selector by @Waguilar33 in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21035
* Update Armenian (hy) translations by @arshaviras in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21023
* Add missing pt_BR translations by @jeffersongoncalves in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21033
* Translate remaining Indonesian strings by @insanrizky in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21034
* fix(panels): guard sidebar collapsedGroups against null by @gopimosali in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21039
* fix: restore FileUpload input synchronously on destroy by @lazerg in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21043
* fix: preserve relationship summary query constraints by @people-sea in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21044
* fix: batch broadcast notifications and simultaneous dismissals by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21045
* perf: do not render dynamic options inline in a non-native select by @Waguilar33 in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21041
* Feature: Render control loading indicators without an SVG per control by @webard in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21018
* fix: let Safari open global search results and actions on click by @ralphjsmit in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21048
* perf: compute sibling repeater values once per field instead of once per option by @DanielDarrenJones in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21052
* perf: query date constraints with index-friendly ranges by @DanielDarrenJones in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21050
* fix: align toggle inline label to the top, level with the switch by @chri1160 in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21053
* perf: evaluate `SelectColumn` options once per cell by @DanielDarrenJones in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21051
* Fix untranslated Indonesian strings by @insanrizky in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21054
* fix: turn off browser form restore on table selection checkboxes by @AsKode in https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/pull/21056
* fix: require validated app authentication recovery codes by @danharrin in https://github.com/filamentphp/filame

detail.readme: **Filament is an open-source framework for building polished, maintainable business software with Laravel.** From a single admin panel to customer portals, CRMs, and operational systems, Filament gives you components and conventions that work together. Build features that fit your organization, with a consistent experience for your users and less custom code for your team to maintain. Business software isn't just for businesses. Filament helps developers build the systems that companies, charities, schools, and public institutions rely on every day. - **Tables** — Browse, search, and filter records, with customizable columns and individual or bulk actions. - **Forms** — Build reactive forms with reusable components, validation, and flexible layouts. - **Infolists** — Present read-only record details with structured layouts and custom formatting. - **Notifications** — Keep users informed with in-app feedback and persistent notifications. - **Dashboard widgets** — Bring key metrics, charts, and records together in one place. - **Actions** — Connect user interactions to application logic, with support for confirmations, forms, and feedback. [Get Started](https://filamentphp.com/docs) • [Launch Demo](https://demo.filamentphp.com) • [Join Discord](https://filamentphp.com/discord) --- ## Contributing Please see our [contributing guide](https://filamentphp.com/docs/5.x/introduction/contributing). ## Need Help? 🐞 If you spot a bug, please [submit a detailed issue](https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml), and wait for assistance. 🤔 If you have a question or feature request, please [start a new discussion](https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/discussions/new/choose). We also have a [Discord community](https://filamentphp.com/discord). For quick help, ask questions in the appropriate channel. 🔐 If you discover a vulnerability, please review our [security policy](https://github.com/filamentphp/filament/blob/4.x/SECURITY.md).
